description: Green, orange or red verdict for a Solana transaction your bot is about to sign, such as the buy after a rug-check. Red: do not sign. Orange: ask the user first. Nothing is signed or sent. Powered by Presign Guard (presign-guard.fizzl.eu, by Fizzl: fizzl.eu), which has the full report with reasons.

intent.description: What the transaction should do, e.g. "buy 0.1 SOL of <mint> on pump.fun"

transaction.description: The base64 wire transaction about to be signed

name: presign_check
title: Check a Solana transaction before signing (Presign Guard)
